-- 4)、last 在bbi上方 select th.stockCode, t.date, concat(th.bkName, '-', th.stockName) last -- , concat('last:', t.last, '; ma5:', t.ma5, '; ma10:', t.ma10, '; ma20:', t.ma20, '; bbi:', round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3)) ratioB , concat('should_win_chg=', round(t3.chg_next_2, 1) , '; last=', round(t.last, 2) , '; chg=', round(t.chg, 1) , '; chg_next_1=', round(t3.chg_next_1, 1) , '; chg_next_2=', round(t3.chg_next_2, 1) , '; ma5=', round(t.ma5, 1) , '; ma10=', round(t.ma10, 1) , '; ma20=', round(t.ma20, 1) , '; bbi=', round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3) , '; info=', 'T+1买(T+2卖)' ) ratioB -- , t3.chg_next_1, t3.chg_next_2 -- , t.last, t.ma5, t.ma10, t.ma20 -- , round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3) bbi from tmp_30_duotou t, tmp_has_5_chg t1, tmp_vol t2, t_stock th, tmp t3 where t.date_rank = 1 and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode and t.tc_date = t1.tc_date and t.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t.tc_date = t2.tc_date and t.stockCode = th.fullStockCode and t.stockCode = t3.stockCode and t.date = t3.date and t3.tc_date = (select max(tc_date) from tmp_calc_dates) and t.last >= round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3) order by 2 desc, 1 desc

replace into t_strategy_result(abbrStockCode, date, strategy_type, attribute‌‌_1) with tmp_date_rank as ( select rank() over (order by `date` desc) date_rn, date from t_index_raw teni where stockCode = '1.000001' and `date` <= #{calcDate} ) , tmp_ans as ( select lag(date, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_date , lag(volume, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_volume , lag(volume, 2) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_volume_2 , lag(volume, 3) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_volume_3 , ten.* from t_stock_raw ten where ten.`date` > (select min(date) from tmp_date_rank where date_rn <=5) and ten.`date` <= (select max(date) from tmp_date_rank where date_rn <=5) ) -- 不要长上引 , tmp_long_shang_yin as ( select distinct ta.stockCode from tmp_ans ta where (ta.high - ta.last) > 2*abs(ta.last-ta.open) and abs(abs(ta.high-ta.low)/ta.last*100) > 6 ) -- 不要跌停过 , tmp_die_ting as ( select distinct ta.stockCode from tmp_ans ta where ta.chg < -9 ) -- select * from tmp_die_ting; -- 必须大振幅 , tmp_big_swing as ( select stockCode, avg(abs(chg)) avg_chg from tmp_ans group by stockCode having avg_chg > 2 ) -- 缩量严重 , tmp_suo_liang as ( select distinct round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume, 2) ratio , tl.stockCode , ta.pre_volume, ta.chg, ta.last, ta.volume, tl.bkName , tl.stockName, ta.date from tmp_ans ta, t_stock_longtou tl, tmp_big_swing tgs where 1 = 1 and ta.date = (select max(date) from tmp_date_rank where date_rn = 1) and ta.stockCode = tl.fullStockCode and ta.chg > -9 and ta.chg < 9 and (round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume, 2) <= 0.68 and ta.last < ta.open or round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume_2, 2) <= 0.68 and ta.last < ta.open /*or round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume_3, 2) <= 0.68*/) and ta.chg < 0 and not exists (select 1 from tmp_die_ting tdt where ta.stockCode = tdt.stockCode) and not exists (select 1 from tmp_long_shang_yin tdt where ta.stockCode = tdt.stockCode) and tl.stockCode not like '3%' and tl.stockCode not like '68%' and tl.stockCode not like '69%' and ta.stockCode = tgs.stockCode ) , tmp_ready as ( select t.ratio, t.stockCode, t.pre_volume, t.volume, t.chg, t.last, th.stockName, group_concat(t.bkName) bkName_multi, t.date from tmp_suo_liang t, t_stock th where t.stockCode = th.stockCode group by t.ratio, t.stockCode, t.pre_volume, t.volume, t.chg, t.last, th.stockName, t.date ) select t.stockCode, t.date, 'strategy_5' strategy_type, t.ratio attribute‌‌_1 -- select t.stockCode, t.date, concat(t.bkName_multi, '-', t.stockName) last -- , concat('suo-liang-ratio=', t.ratio, '; pre-vol=', t.pre_volume, '; vol=', t.volume, '; last=', t.last, '; chg=', t.chg) ratioB from tmp_ready t , ( -- 多头排列 with tmp_codes as (select distinct fullStockCode from t_stock_longtou) , tmp_rank as ( select ten.date, ten.chg, ten.stockCode, ten.`last` , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by ten.`date` desc) date_rank from t_stock_raw ten, tmp_codes tc where ten.stockCode = tc.fullStockCode and ten.date < '2099-01-01' and `date` <= #{calcDate} AND ten.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(SYSDATE() , INTERVAL -90 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) -- select * from tmp_rank; , tmp_duotou as ( select t1.date, t1.date_rank, t1.stockCode, t1.chg, t1.last -- , max(t1.last) `last` , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 5 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma5 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 10 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma10 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 20 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma20 -- 计算均线 -- , sum(case when t1.date_rank + 20 > t2.date_rank then 1 else 0 end) ma_cnt -- 计算均线天数 from tmp_rank t1, tmp_rank t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t1.date_rank <= t2.date_rank group by t1.date, t1.date_rank, t1.stockCode, t1.chg, t1.last having last >= ma5 and ma5 >= ma10 * 0.98 and ma10 >= ma20 * 0.98 ) -- select * from tmp_30_duotou; ) select distinct t2.stockCode from tmp_today t1, t_stock_longtou t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.fullStockCode ) t1 where t.stockCode = t1.stockCode order by t.ratio, 3;
mapper.select: with tmp_codes as ( select distinct abbrStockCode, tl.fullStockCode from t_strategy_result t, t_stock_longtou tl where t.date > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and t.abbrStockCode = tl.stockCode ) , tmp_code_bk as ( select t.abbrStockCode, tl.fullStockCode, max(tl.stockName ) stockName, group_concat(tl.bkName) bkName_multi from tmp_codes t, t_stock_longtou tl where t.abbrStockCode = tl.stockCode group by t.abbrStockCode, tl.fullStockCode ) , tmp_node as ( select lead(last, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) next_last_1 , lead(last, 2) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) next_last_2 , lead(last, 3) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) next_last_3 , lead(last, 4) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) next_last_4 , lead(last, 5) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) next_last_5 , ten.* , tc.bkName_multi , tc.stockName , tc.abbrStockCode from t_stock_raw ten, tmp_code_bk tc where ten.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and ten.`date` <= '2222-01-01' and ten.stockCode = tc.fullStockCode ) select t.abbrStockCode stockCode, tsr.date, concat(t.bkName_multi, '-', t.stockName) last, tsr.attribute‌‌_1 , concat('suo-liang-ratio=', tsr.attribute‌‌_1 , case when t.next_last_1 is not null then concat('; next_chg_1=', round(t.next_last_1/t.last*100-100,1)) else '' end , case when t.next_last_2 is not null then concat('; next_chg_2=', round(t.next_last_2/t.last*100-100,1)) else '' end , case when t.next_last_3 is not null then concat('; with tmp_around_10_lowest as ( select tsc.* , rank() over (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date`) AS date_rn -- , MIN(tsc.cci20) OVER (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date` ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS min_val_around_10 , MIN(tsc.cci20) OVER (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date` ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_val_around_10 , max(tsc.cci20) OVER (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date` ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_val_around_10 from t_stock_cci tsc where tsc.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -250 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and SUBSTRING(tsc.stockCode, 3) not like '3%' and SUBSTRING(tsc.stockCode, 3) not like '68%' -- and tsc.stockCode in ('0.002025', '1.603920', '1.600522') -- and tsc.`date` <= '2026-07-16' ) , tmp_data as ( select t1.date, t1.stockCode, t1.cci20, ter.`last` , LAG(t1.cci20, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY t1.stockCode ORDER BY t1.`date`) AS pre_cci20 , LAG(ter.last, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY ter.stockCode ORDER BY ter.`date`) AS pre_last , LAG(ter.date, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY ter.stockCode ORDER BY ter.`date`) AS pre_date , t1.date_rn , LAG(t1.date_rn, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY t1.stockCode ORDER BY t1.`date`) AS pre_date_rn from tmp_around_10_lowest t1, t_stock_raw ter where 1 = 1 and (t1.cci20 = min_val_around_10 or max_val_around_10 > -100) and t1.stockCode = ter.stockCode and t1.date = ter.`date` and min_val_around_10 < -100 ) , tmp_ans as ( select SUBSTRING(t.stockCode, 3) stockCode, t.date, t1.stockName, t.cci20 - t.pre_cci20 delta , case WHEN t.last < t.pre_last AND t.cci20 > t.pre_cci20 AND t.cci20 < -100 THEN '底背离（买入信号）' WHEN t.last > t.pre_last AND t.cci20 < t.pre_cci20 AND t.cci20 > 100 THEN '顶背离（卖出信号）' ELSE '无背离' END AS divergence_signal , t.cci20, t.pre_cci20 , t.last, t.pre_last , t.pre_date from tmp_data t, t_stock t1 where t.cci20 > t.pre_cci20 and t.last < t.pre_last and t.stockCode = t1.fullStockCode and t.date_rn >= t.pre_date_rn + 5 and t.date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) select t.stockCode, t.date, t.stockName last , concat('delta=', round(t.delta, 1), ';last=', t.last, ';cci20=', t.cci20, '(pre_date=', pre_date, ';pre_last=', t.pre_last, ';pre_cci20=', t.pre_cci20, ')') ratioB from tmp_ans t -- where t.stockCode = '600602' order by 2 desc, delta desc

with tmp_around_10_lowest as ( select tsc.* , rank() over (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date`) AS date_rn -- , MIN(tsc.cci20) OVER (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date` ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS min_val_around_10 , MIN(tsc.cci20) OVER (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date` ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_val_around_10 , max(tsc.cci20) OVER (PARTITION BY tsc.stockCode ORDER BY tsc.`date` ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_val_around_10 from t_etf_cci tsc where tsc.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -250 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and SUBSTRING(tsc.stockCode, 3) not like '3%' and SUBSTRING(tsc.stockCode, 3) not like '68%' -- and tsc.stockCode in ('0.002025', '1.603920', '1.600522') -- and tsc.`date` <= '2026-07-16' ) , tmp_data as ( select t1.date, t1.stockCode, t1.cci20, ter.`last` , LAG(t1.cci20, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY t1.stockCode ORDER BY t1.`date`) AS pre_cci20 , LAG(ter.last, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY ter.stockCode ORDER BY ter.`date`) AS pre_last , LAG(ter.date, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY ter.stockCode ORDER BY ter.`date`) AS pre_date , t1.date_rn , LAG(t1.date_rn, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY t1.stockCode ORDER BY t1.`date`) AS pre_date_rn from tmp_around_10_lowest t1, t_etf_raw ter where 1 = 1 and (t1.cci20 = min_val_around_10 or max_val_around_10 > -100) and t1.stockCode = ter.stockCode and t1.date = ter.`date` and min_val_around_10 < -100 ) , tmp_ans as ( select SUBSTRING(t.stockCode, 3) stockCode, t.date, t1.stockName, t.cci20 - t.pre_cci20 delta , case WHEN t.last < t.pre_last AND t.cci20 > t.pre_cci20 AND t.cci20 < -100 THEN '底背离（买入信号）' WHEN t.last > t.pre_last AND t.cci20 < t.pre_cci20 AND t.cci20 > 100 THEN '顶背离（卖出信号）' ELSE '无背离' END AS divergence_signal , t.cci20, t.pre_cci20 , t.last, t.pre_last , t.pre_date from tmp_data t, t_etf t1 where t.cci20 > t.pre_cci20 and t.last < t.pre_last and t.stockCode = t1.fullStockCode and t.date_rn >= t.pre_date_rn + 5 and t.date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) select t.stockCode, t.date, t.stockName last , concat('delta=', round(t.delta, 1), ';last=', t.last, ';cci20=', t.cci20, '(pre_date=', pre_date, ';pre_last=', t.pre_last, ';pre_cci20=', t.pre_cci20, ')') ratioB from tmp_ans t -- where t.stockCode = '600602' order by 2 desc, delta desc
